content.description: Iteration 1: lower red-running probability toward the observed 9% moto share, switch on early start toward 13%, enable small right-lane and sidewalk seeking at short queues; car and car-following values stay at Saval.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car discharge headway (0.387 s) and M6 car approach/junction times; Saval Table 11 values kept unchanged because there is no feedback yet showing they are off. Share 0.95 so that with car_seeker 0.05 the car distribution sums to 1.

Targets M9a/M9b (straight vehicles in the right-turn lane, 0.33 veh/cycle, 2% of right-turners blocked): the observed rate is small, so the car seeker share is lowered from 0.1 to 0.05. Car-following params identical to car_saval so M1/car is unaffected.

Targets M1/moto (0.30 s discharge headway), M4/overshoot_share and M5 queue density; Saval values kept (tau 0.8 s, minGapLat at its 0.3 m lower bound allows dense filtering). Share 0.85 so that with moto_seeker 0.15 the moto distribution sums to 1.

Targets M10a (0.27 sidewalk motorcycles per cycle) and M9a (0.33 straight vehicles per cycle in the right-turn lane): the only riders allowed to seek space, so their share is raised from 0.1 to 0.15 to give enough candidates for the small p values. Params identical to moto_saval.

Targets M7a/M7b/M6 illegal_l junction time (49 s) and release time (2.6 s). No feedback yet showing the box waiters leave too early or late, so jmTimegapMinor stays at 1.0 s; I change few things at a time. Share is 1 as the only archetype of the moto_violator distribution.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (observed 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (4.4 veh/cycle). The Saval p = 0.5 applies to front-row riders only, while the observed share is over all motorcycles, so lowering p0 to 0.2 pulls the simulated red-running share down toward 0.09. k stays 0 until M3/var_to_mean (1.3) shows overdispersion is missing.

Targets M2/early/moto (observed 0.130 share in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s). Switching p from 0 to 0.3 per front-row rider creates early starters; 0.3 of front-row riders is about 0.13 of all given the front-row fraction. t_before_green 7 s is within the 4-10 s lead-time target; v_max 2.5 m/s is slow creep.

Targets F2/p/right_lane (0.006-0.031 at q below 40 m), F2/p/sidewalk (0.005-0.016), M9c and M10b (choice at 12.7-13.3 m queue). q is lowered from 30 to 20 m so the draw triggers at the short observed queues; p_right_lane and p_sidewalk 0.04 each, given only 15 percent of riders are seekers, give small event rates near M9a 0.33 and M10a 0.27 per cycle. p_wrong_lane is 0 because it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27). v_creep 4 m/s is near the proxy sidewalk speed.

reasoning: First iteration with no simulation feedback: keep Saval car-following values, change only levers with a clear mechanism. Lower red-run probability (0.5 to 0.2) toward the observed 9% moto red-running share, enable early start (p 0.3) toward 13%, lower the seeker trigger queue to 20 m to match short observed queues and give small right-lane and sidewalk probabilities, and adjust seeker shares so distributions sum to 1.
